run_submission_file_cli: run the make_challenge_submission_file script with --path and --out-path args to create a NeurIPS 2021 Open Catalyst Challenge submission file
run_is2re_relaxations_submission: run the script with --is2re-relaxations flag to write IS2RE results from a directory of .traj trajectory files
run_hybrid_is2re_submission: run the script with --is2re-relaxations and --hybrid flags to write IS2RE results from S2EF .npz prediction files
create_predictions_submission: create a submission file by running write_predictions to convert an NPZ results file into evalAI challenge format with challenge_ prefixed keys
create_is2re_relaxation_submission: create an IS2RE submission file by running write_is2re_relaxations to extract energies from .traj files or hybrid S2EF predictions
